acceptanceGates: Recompute and verify package.json and package-lock.json SHA-256 at every governance run.
Revalidate imported upstream license evidence during the exact network-enabled checkpoint.
Any dependency-input drift requires regenerated license and convergence policies.
No new duplicate package name or version on a duplicate name without owner review.
Run npm audit and registry-backed license/SBOM scan before public exact promotion.
Bind final lockfile, SBOM, advisory scan, license evidence and convergence policy into production attestation.
limitations: Exact npm registry metadata, archive integrity and license-file digests are technical evidence, not legal advice.
0 transitive packages lack complete license metadata in the bound offline inventory and remain tracked for review.
This policy does not claim a live registry, advisory, hosted-build or production checkpoint.
